$schema.description: URL of the exporter's JSON Schema.

project.description: Global project name displayed in the header of the exported context (default: BuildIt).

header.description: Custom instruction or header text for the AI (replaces the default guidelines block).

defineVersionString.description: Custom identifier for the version constant for replacement in headers and instructions (default: __APP_VERSION__).

modes.description: Dictionary containing the configuration for each export mode.

outputFile.description: Path to the generated Markdown file.

includes.description: List of glob patterns for file inclusion (supports wildcards and brace expansion like {src,public}/**/*.{ts,tsx}).

excludes.description: List of glob patterns for file exclusion (e.g., **/*.test.ts, **/dist/**).

includeVersion.description: If true, injects the current project version at the top.

customInstruction.description: Orientation message for the AI model.

header.description: Custom instruction or header text for the AI specific to this mode.

project.description: Project name specific to this mode (overrides the global one).

default.description: Whether the mode should be executed by default.
